# Never Leave Your Wingman

> An open-source, file-based "second brain" starter for AI coding agents. One set of rules
> (AGENTS.md), reusable skills, agent handoffs and prompt-injection defences, kept as plain
> markdown in git. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and any agent that reads
> AGENTS.md. MIT licensed.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/PixelSpiderSense/never-leave-your-wingman/blob/master/README.md): what it is, quick start, FAQ
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/PixelSpiderSense/never-leave-your-wingman/blob/master/AGENTS.md): the shared rules every agent reads
- [GLOBAL-AGENTS.md](https://github.com/PixelSpiderSense/never-leave-your-wingman/blob/master/GLOBAL-AGENTS.md): the same rules at user level
- [SETUP.md](https://github.com/PixelSpiderSense/never-leave-your-wingman/blob/master/SETUP.md): how each tool loads the rules

## Key facts
- Rules live in AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md contain only `@AGENTS.md`.
- Five agent roles (ceo, coder, memory, reviewer, scribe) hand work off through inbox/outbox notes.
- Eleven skills as plain SKILL.md files in .claude/skills/.
- Safety: untrusted-input policy, scripts/scan_untrusted.py, scripts/check_staged_secrets.py,
  a pre-commit hook, and confirm-exact-content-before-saving rules for memory and config.
- No accounts or hosted services. Slack and Notion mirrors are optional and off by default.
